patch_description: consolidate pre- and post-entanglement rz gates by sharing a single parameter per group (rz_corner, rz_edge, rz_center) across both layers. This reduces parameter count from 11 to 8 per block, increases parameter efficiency, and enforces stronger symmetry. Implement by updating the hybrid ansatz to apply rz_corner/rz_edge/rz_center in both the pre- and post-entanglement layers using the same parameter keys.
